title: Three against four — Let two opposite answers meet the first or last Three note
help: Three leaves its middle note silent. Four keeps two notes six slots apart. Offset zero meets the first Three note, one misses both, and two meets the last. A meeting keeps both voices; an unchecked note remains a rest.
